tasks.name: Upgrade Java Runtime to 25 and Spring Boot to 4.x
tasks.description: Upgrade Java runtime from version 21 to the latest stable version 25, and Spring Boot from 3.3.3 to 4.x. This includes Spring Framework 7.x upgrade and Jakarta EE namespace migration (javax.* → jakarta.*). This is a prerequisite for all subsequent security and deployment tasks.
requirements: Update pom.xml Java version property from 21 to 25
Update Spring Boot parent version from 3.3.3 to 4.x
Migrate all javax.* imports to jakarta.* equivalents
Update all Spring Boot starter dependencies to 4.x compatible versions
Update Spring Cloud Azure dependencies for Java 25 compatibility
Review and update any version-specific configuration
Execute full test suite to ensure compatibility
acceptance_criteria: Maven build completes successfully with no errors
All unit tests pass with upgraded versions
Integration tests pass in staging environment
No deprecation warnings for Java 25 or Spring Boot 4.x
Application starts successfully with upgraded versions

tasks.name: Migrate Plaintext Credentials to Azure Key Vault
tasks.description: Remove hardcoded plaintext credentials and secrets from configuration files and source code. Implement Azure Key Vault integration for secure credential management. This addresses the identified issue of passwords found in configuration files and default/well-known credentials.
requirements: Identify all hardcoded credentials in application.properties and source code
Add Azure Identity and Azure Key Vault Secret dependencies to pom.xml
Implement SecretClient for Key Vault credential retrieval
Update Spring Boot configuration to use Key Vault-backed properties
Create Azure Key Vault secrets for all credentials (database password, API keys, tokens)
Update application.properties to remove plaintext credentials
Implement proper error handling for Key Vault access
Configure managed identity for local development and Azure deployment
acceptance_criteria: No plaintext passwords in application.properties
No hardcoded credentials in Java source code
Azure Key Vault integration tests pass
Application retrieves credentials from Key Vault successfully
Local development works with managed identity or local credentials
Security scan shows no exposed credentials

tasks.name: Secure PostgreSQL Database with Azure Managed Identity
tasks.description: Migrate PostgreSQL database authentication from password-based to Azure Managed Identity for passwordless, secure database connections. This removes the need for hardcoded database passwords and implements Azure best practices for credential-free authentication.
requirements: Add Spring Cloud Azure PostgreSQL starter dependency (spring-cloud-azure-starter-jdbc-postgresql)
Update application.properties to remove database password and configure for managed identity
Update DataSource configuration to use Azure Managed Identity
Update Spring Data JPA configuration for managed identity support
Configure Azure PostgreSQL instance to support managed identity
Update JDBC connection string format for managed identity authentication
Test database connectivity using managed identity
Implement fallback authentication for local development environment
acceptance_criteria: PostgreSQL connection established using managed identity
No database password in application.properties
Integration tests pass with managed identity authentication
Database operations (CRUD on Product entity) work correctly
Connection pooling works properly with managed identity
Local development environment has proper fallback authentication
Azure PostgreSQL instance is configured for managed identity support
affected_components: pom.xml (new Spring Cloud Azure PostgreSQL dependency)
security_issues_addressed: PostgreSQL database connections using plaintext passwords

tasks.name: Security Scanning and Vulnerability Remediation
tasks.description: Execute comprehensive security scanning to identify and remediate CVEs in dependencies after runtime upgrade to Java 25 and Spring Boot 4.x. Ensure all vulnerable packages are updated to secure versions.
requirements: Run Maven dependency check to identify CVEs
Review identified vulnerabilities and their severity
Update vulnerable dependencies to patched versions
Re-run security scan to confirm all CVEs are remediated
Verify application functionality with patched dependencies
Document any unpatched critical vulnerabilities and mitigation strategies
acceptance_criteria: No critical or high-severity CVEs in dependencies
Security scan completes with passing status
All tests pass after dependency updates
No new deprecation warnings introduced
Security report is generated and documented

tasks.name: Containerization - Create Docker Image
tasks.description: Optimize and prepare Docker configuration for production deployment. Ensure the application container is properly configured for Azure Container Apps or App Service deployment with proper health checks, resource limits, and security best practices.
requirements: Review and optimize existing Dockerfile for production use
Update base image to use Java 25 runtime
Implement multi-stage Docker build for optimized image size
Configure proper health check endpoint
Set resource requests and limits
Implement security best practices (non-root user, minimal base image)
Build and test Docker image locally
Verify application functionality inside container
acceptance_criteria: Docker image builds successfully
Container runs without errors
All API endpoints respond correctly inside container
Health check endpoint returns 200 status
Container image size is optimized
Image follows Azure container best practices
Image can be pushed to Azure Container Registry

tasks.name: Deploy Application to Azure
tasks.description: Deploy the modernized and containerized gestao-sistema application to Azure infrastructure. Configure managed identity, Key Vault access, and PostgreSQL database connections for the deployed application.
requirements: Create Azure Container Registry for image storage
Push Docker image to Azure Container Registry
Create Azure Container Apps environment and container app instance
Configure container app environment variables and secrets reference to Key Vault
Set up managed identity for container app
Configure RBAC and Key Vault access policies
Configure networking and ingress rules
Set up logging and monitoring with Application Insights
Configure health probes and auto-scaling policies
Test deployed application endpoints

JWT authentication works in production
PostgreSQL database connections use managed identity
Credentials are retrieved from Key Vault
Application logs are visible in Application Insights
Health check endpoint is accessible
